paragraphs: At morning rounds, align discharge preparation with physicians. During the morning, train gait with a hip-replacement patient and remove the walker to assess balance. Around midday, facilitate neurological movement in a patient with hemiplegia while praising small gains. In the afternoon, provide equipment-based therapy and teach family members home exercises. Before leaving, document progress and set next week's goals.

In short: help people train their bodies back. Tasks include functional assessment, plan development, manual and exercise therapy, equipment use, and teaching home prevention. It combines manual and intellectual work and leads functional recovery.
